What we believe in at Henig Diamonds

Henig Diamonds employs a team of diamond connoisseurs, with a passion to provide the best service and share their expertise with clientele. We are a family business at our core, which is fitting to the values we exhibit, by consistently providing a personalised experience when working with us.

Henig Diamonds will forever maintain a traditional approach to diamond dealing, whilst continuously revolutionising our method of supplying spectacular diamonds; As a progressive forward-looking business, we strive for perfection, and we do not plan on slowing down.
Our UK office is backed by 60+ years of history

Our UK office is comprised of diamond connoisseurs that work attentively with gemmological institutes and laboratories throughout Europe and America, resulting in sourcing the most specialised and diverse diamonds.

Our client-comes-first philosophy has revolutionised what it means to source the most exquisite diamonds. Above all, we strictly supply ethically sourced diamonds through reputable suppliers who adhere to the standards honoured by the RJC.

value.title: I have never made an online diamond purchase before, how can I be sure Henig is a reputable brand?
value.content: Henig Diamonds has been operating in the diamond industry for over 30 years and has built its own prestigious reputation. Furthermore, we are established members of 5 governing bodies that ensure the highest sourcing practises. This includes, The National Association of Jewellers, Jewellers of Excellence, British Jewellers association, The London Diamond Bourse and The Responsible Jewellery Council.

value.title: Why should I choose Henig?
value.content: Henig diamonds have spent years sourcing the best diamonds from around the globe. Nowhere else do you have such a high-quality selection of loose diamonds to choose from.

value.title: Where is your showroom located?
value.content: We are located in Hatton Garden, London. Hatton Garden has a reputation dating back to Medieval Times when groups of particular talents clustered in groups to ease conversations, trade and supply. Hatton Garden was known for it’s collection of “quality craftsmanship”. It’s origin morphed into jewellery and it’s reputation has stood the test of time since then. This is why it’s the perfect place for Henig to be located.

value.title: Can I arrange a viewing of the diamond before purchasing it?
value.content: Of course, you can. Book a meeting here.

value.title: How do I book an appointment?
value.content: All you need to do is email or call our front of house staff and request what you would like to inspect. Contact us here. Use a link from our website to inform us of the stone you would like to see.

value.title: Where do your diamonds come from?
value.content: Our diamonds are sourced from a variety of locations around the world. They are all conflict-free and supplied by a partner of De Beers; Trau bros. read more here.

value.title: How are your diamonds sourced?
value.content: Our diamonds are sourced in established independent mines around the globe. All our diamonds are quality checked by Henig Gemologists. Continue reading....

value.title: Are your diamonds sourced using conflict free sources?
value.content: Yes they are, all our suppliers adhere to the highest DTC Best Practice Principles. We accept nothing less. Continue reading...

value.title: How is my order packaged?
value.content: Once you have placed your orders, the weight, size and security risk all determine the packaging and delivery method used. Please contact us to find out more.

value.title: Can I track my order?
value.content: Yes. Once you have made an account with Henig, you will be able to use our control panel to directly track your order. To do this all you need is the tracking number found on any order or invoice document from Henig.   If you're trying to track a package now or cannot find our tracking number, please contact us.

value.title: How do you calculate duties and taxes?
value.content: When items are sent out of the UK, they become exempt from UK duties and taxes. This means that you will be required to adhere to your local import rules and regulations. Contact your local customs or import office to find out more information about your local import rules. However, we at Henig are happy to provide a quote and guide you through the process.

value.title: Can my order be delivered internationally?
value.content: Yes, we can deliver to any location in the world.

value.title: Is international shipping free?
value.content: No, we charge for international shipping. However, for orders over a certain financial value we can come to an arrangement.

value.title: Are orders insured for delivery?
value.content: We use the Royal Mail Special delivery for all our UK deliveries so all items are fully insured. Our global orders are delivered by couriers; FedEx and DHL and are insured up until the point of delivery. On occasions, our delivery method may vary.

value.title: Can I personally collect my order?
value.content: Yes you can. You are welcome to visit our store in Hatton Garden London. Just book a meeting here.

value.title: How safe is my order in transit?
value.content: We haven't lost a package in 30+ years.

value.title: Do you offer a warranty on the merchandise I purchase from Henig?
value.content: We offer a lifetime warranty excluding any excessive ware or abuse of the products. Our warranty covers manufacturing defects and workmanship to the stone. Our warranty is not insurance.

value.title: How do I best care and maintain my new jewellery purchase?
value.content: There are ways of cleaning diamonds if the shine ever starts to fade which doesn't happen in Henig Diamonds very often. You can read more about it here.

value.title: How can I safeguard my purchase against damage, theft, or a loss?
value.content: We always use discrete packaging to minimise the likelihood of this. We recommend you follow security measures wherever you store your purchase.

value.title: What do you consider to be manufacturing defects?
value.content: If a diamond is different in any way from it’s GIA certificate. We deem it to be damaged. Please let us know if you think this is the case with one of your gemstones. When contacting us, please attach the GIA certificate that came with your purchase so we can effectively serve you.

value.title: What are examples of wear and tear that are not covered?
value.content: Extreme temperatures or hard impacts are not covered under the Henig warranty. When diamond experiences a hard impact, the area where the carbon bonds are weakest can crack or chip.

value.title: What will void the warranty?
value.content: Nothing, we will cover any deviation from it’s GIA specifications...

value.title: Do you have a diamond price guarantee policy?
value.content: Yes, the price you see on the website is the price we sell the diamonds for. We update our special offers section several times a month so keep an eye on that.

value.title: What is your return policy?
value.content: You can make a return within 30 days.

value.title: Am I required to use Henig's return shipping method?
value.content: Yes, we must arrange the shipping or collection of your diamonds.

value.title: Do I pay the return shipping costs?
value.content: Content goes here...

value.title: How should I package my return for shipping?
value.content: We will arrange for the items to be returned using our trusted and secure delivery methods.

value.title: How long will it take Henig to process my merchandise return?
value.content: This will depend but we intend to process refunds as quickly as possible.

value.title: I am expecting my returned item to be replaced. How long does it take to reach me?
value.content: This does depend on how you would like to move forward, we can either replace your items or process a cash refund. We are also happy to offer credit if that’s more suitable for you.

value.title: Will I be notified during the merchandise returns process?
value.content: Yes, you will be contacted by one of our Account Managers.

value.title: Will Henig update me during the return process?
value.content: Henig diamonds values all of its customers and will provide the utmost care during a refund process.

value.title: Can I track the status of my return?
value.content: You cannot track it online but you will receive regular updates from our support teams during the process as the case develops.

value.title: Is it safe to order online?
value.content: Yes, our website is protected by a modern SSL certification, we are regulated by the Responsible Jewellery Council and your payment is processed securely by Visa.

value.title: What payment methods do you offer?
value.content: We are only able to process payments online or in-person in our showroom in Hatten Garden. We do not take cash.

value.title: Do I have to pay VAT?
value.content: If you are buying from within the UK you will be subject to the VAT rate of 20%. If you are purchasing from outside the UK then are subject to your local VAT laws. You may also be subject to import duties and taxes as the item/s enter your country.

value.title: Do you offer finance plans?
value.content: Yes, we do. Please contact us to arrange this. Let us know which items you would like to buy, how many, and how you plan on selling your stock.

value.title: Are discounts available?
value.content: We have a dedicated “special offers” section on our website just for this. You can view it here.

value.title: When is the best time to buy a diamond?
value.content: The price of diamonds and gold does vary from year to year. The price of gold tends to go up with quarterly buying opportunities but diamonds tend to fluctuate up and down depending on supply and demand. The variation is around 12%.

value.title: Why do nearly identical diamonds differ in price?
value.content: That is the point. “Nearly identical”. Diamonds have subtle differences that only a trained eye can see. However, diamonds that have higher scoring qualities shine like no other. We like to think we source only the best diamonds that shine eternally. These are the diamonds that you want to sell.

value.title: Can you engrave a diamond?
value.content: Yes you can engrave a diamond, the methods of this have changed throughout the years. Diamond engraving is now done via a large powerful laser.

value.title: I’m interested in learning more about a diamond. Is it possible to book an appointment with a specialist?
value.content: Yes and we encourage you to do so. Contact us here. Let us know which item/s you would like to inspect by using our website link.

value.title: Can you provide HD images of the diamond I’m interested in?
value.content: Yes, we have HD pictures of all of our diamonds and can send you more detailed pictures if you need. Please contact us here to do so and let us know which stone you would like to look at by using the URL or web address.

value.title: How long does it take to receive HD images of the diamond?
value.content: We will send you pictures within 48 hours of a request.

value.title: Are lab grown diamonds real?
value.content: Yes, lab-grown diamonds are technically 100% real diamonds. They are chemically, physically, and optically identical to earth-grown diamonds. A lab-grown diamond will test as a diamond using a diamond detector. However, it's also a fact that natural diamonds contain more character than lab-grown diamonds. The carbon atomic structure of a lab-grown diamond may be real, but the experience and shine of a real diamond cannot be beaten in our opinion. Read more here.

value.title: Are lab grown diamonds better than earth grown diamonds?
value.content: People often assume that lab-grown diamonds are more “perfect” than earth-grown diamonds. Lab-grown diamonds can still have inclusions, just like earth-grown diamonds. When choosing between a lab-grown diamond or an earth-grown diamond, it’s really all about preference. Some people love that lab-grown diamonds can be up to 30% less expensive, while others love that natural diamonds are produced by Mother Nature. It’s the knowledge that you have the real thing that gives natural diamonds the edge.

value.title: Can you tell the difference between a lab grown diamond and an earth grown diamond?
value.content: Since lab-grown diamonds are chemically the same as earth-grown diamonds, you cannot tell them apart, even with a loupe. BUT. natural diamonds do contain tiny amounts of Nitrogen and laser inscription and unique fluorescence are other ways of detecting a natural diamond. However, a lab-grown diamond is technically not a “fake” but a pure man-made version of what the planet naturally creates within its tectonic crust.

value.title: What is total carat weight?
value.content: Total carat weight (abbreviated as CTW or CWT) refers to the combined weight of all of the diamonds in a piece of jewelry. For example, 1 CTW diamond studs mean that each diamond earring is 0.50 carats.

value.title: What is the minimum total carat weight?
value.content: Minimum total carat weight refers to the lowest combined weight of all of the diamonds in a piece of jewelry.

Henig Diamonds understands that our business policies and practices have the potential to affect people and the environment in and around the facility we operate, as well as in the countries and communities from where our diamonds originate, and the towns and factories where they are cut and polished. Henig Diamonds is conscientious in carrying out due diligence in the selection of our diamond suppliers and sources. 

We appreciate that training employees in practical health and safety measures can reduce accidents and risks in the workplace. Health and safety is a priority and we ensure our office and workforce are properly prepared and equipped to carry out our business activities safely and securely. We are committed to minimising any negative environmental impact and to ensure that our activities do not cause lasting or significant harm to the environment.

These core sustainability and corporate accountability policies (Core Policies) include a code of business ethics and conduct and our commitments to industry best practices and standards, to the health and safety of our employees, to protect the environment, to respect and uphold human rights, and to support local causes. 
Our Core Policies have been developed under a mandate of our senior management, with the participation of our employees and were adopted by our Directors and General Manager in January 2018. The Core Policies are the basis for our way of doing business and of our ethical and legal behaviour. Senior management reviews our systems for managing environmental, social and human rights risks and our operating practices at least once a year, to ensure they are adequate and appropriate. During this review, any changes to the Core Policies deemed necessary will be made and approved by the management team. It is a requirement for all Henig Diamonds personnel to read and formally acknowledge the importance of the Core Policies and respect their application as part of their contracts.
value.title: What is your corporate accountability policy?
What is your code of business ethics and conduct?
value.content:
Henig Diamonds’ Code of Business Ethics and Conduct (the Code) is intended to affirm our commitment to fundamental responsible practices in business and to guide our employees, managers and directors on how to conduct the company's activities.

Respecting the law and avoiding legal violations are essential tenets of the Code. Henig Diamonds provides a baseline for behaviour and legal compliance, covering at least the minimum that is required. However, in most circumstances, our standards go beyond legal requirements. The Code includes our stand on legal compliance, how we treat each other in the workplace, corruption, transparency and disclosure, and the integrity of our products.

value.title: How does Henig always ensure it's legally compliant?
value.content: We conduct all our activities in strict compliance with the national laws of the countries where we operate and with all relevant international conventions where those are applicable in the country of operation. It is the responsibility of our directors, financial officers and managers to know and keep abreast of changes to laws and regulations that affect our business. We are also members of the National Association of Jewellers (NAJ), the London Diamond Bourse and Houlden.

We forbid child and forced labour and all forms of discrimination in the work place. We aim to ensure equal treatment of all our employees, based on merit and performance. We value our employees and the commitment they have made to Henig Diamonds, and we take seriously the investment the company has made in them. We ensure employees are informed and trained in order that they may carry out their duties effectively, safely and securely. We endeavour to have an enjoyable workplace and as such expect our staff members to treat each other with respect.
value.title: What is your approach to members of staff and people in your supply chain?
How do you ensure that Henig doesn't support Modern Slavery?
value.content: Henig Diamonds has a zero-tolerance approach to Human Trafficking and acts of Slavery from occurring both within our business and in our supply chain. We operate a strict procurement process and conduct due diligence to ensure suppliers conform to all applicable laws and regulations, including those relating to the Modern Slavery Act 2015. Our recruitment and procurement due diligence procedures detail the steps we take to identify and to mitigate the risks of slavery occurring in our business.

Henig Diamonds is committed to ensuring no employee should be dismissed or penalised by Henig Diamonds for disclosing serious concerns related to Henig Diamonds or their employment within the organisation.

We provide training to staff on anonymous whistleblowing and our grievance procedures. In the event of disciplinary action against an employee or a grievance raised by an employee, Henig Diamonds follows the Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitrations Service (ACAS) Code of Practice for Disciplinary and Grievance Procedures.
value.title: Do you have a whistleblowing and grievances policy?
How does Henig avoid bribery, facilitation and money laundering?
value.content: We are fully aware that corruption is a persistent issue in many countries. We do not tolerate bribery or facilitation payments of any kind. In all our business dealings we conduct thorough due diligence and follow the principles of “Know Your Customer” and maintain records of all our transactions to avoid working with organisations or individuals who are involved in the illicit movement of money. It is the policy of the company to prohibit and actively prevent money laundering and any activity that facilitates money laundering or the funding of terrorist or criminal activities by complying with all applicable requirements under the UK Money Laundering Regulations 2017 and its implementing regulations.

value.title: How does Henig achieve a conflict free status?
value.content: Henig Diamonds only purchase diamonds in accordance with the Kimberley Process and we apply the World Diamond Council’s System of Warranties. We check the Kimberley Process website for updates (e.g. Fake certificate alerts).

We supply natural and treated diamonds and use rigorous testing to ensure our supply chains remain free of synthetics. We practice complete honesty and transparency in our business and follow the RJC Product Disclosure guidance and monitor CIBJO Diamond Commission and WDCs announcements about claims on synthetic-free diamonds. We follow the Guidance issued on supply chains under section 54(9) of the Modern Slavery Act 2015.
value.title: How do you ensure that all your diamonds are real?
How does Henig's responsibility compare?
value.content:
Henig Diamonds strives to distinguish itself as an industry leader by conforming to the highest standards and management systems across its business functions and activities. Henig Diamonds is a member of the Responsible Jewellery Council (RJC).

RJC is a standards-setting organisation that was established to increase consumers’ confidence in the jewellery industry by promoting responsible, ethical, human rights, social and environmental practices throughout the jewellery supply chain. The RJC has developed a comprehensive system of standards (which are available at (www.responsiblejewellery.com) applicable to all businesses in the jewellery supply chain, and a credible mechanism for verifying compliance to its standards through third-party auditors.

value.title: What is Henig's approach to health and Safety?
value.content: We are committed to a safe and healthy workplace and incorporating health and safety into organisational culture for our employees by working to the highest international standards. We provide in-depth health and safety information for our employees. Henig Diamonds has two members of personnel trained in Adult First Aid, cardio-pulmonary resuscitation and Automated External Defibrillators. It is the responsibility of all employees and contractors to co-operate to enable all statutory duties to be complied with and employees must ensure their own health and safety at work and the health and safety of anyone else who might be affected by their behaviour.

Henig Diamonds is committed to the continual improvement of our environmental performance. We recognise the imperative to manage the risks of our activities in relation to energy and waste management. We operate a strict energy-saving policy for all our electronic equipment and lighting, and a comprehensive recycling program. Henig Diamonds complies with all national legal environmental requirements.
value.title: What is Henig's environmental policy?
How does Henig Diamonds support human rights?
value.content:
We do not discriminate against employees on the basis of race, caste, origin, religion, disability, gender, sexual orientation, union or political affiliation or age. Henig Diamonds is committed to ensuring all human rights are upheld in line with the United Kingdom Equality and Human Rights Commission https://www.equalityhumanrights.com/en; the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights regarding all employees and any other people who interact with Henig Diamonds. 

We recognise and respect the rights of employees to freely associate, organise and bargain collectively in accordance with the UK Government Working, Jobs and Pensions department guidelines. https://www.gov.uk/browse/working Henig Diamonds complies with the UK Government’s Working, Jobs and Pensions guidelines regarding minimum wages, standard working hours and employee benefits. 


We have developed internal management systems to ensure respect for international standards of human rights. Henig Diamonds ensures any incidents of non-compliance with international standards of human rights are investigated and addressed in an appropriate manner without compromising confidentiality or placing at risk any individuals or groups involved. Employees found to be in breach of any of our policies could face disciplinary proceedings.

January 2018
Abie Issacharoff – General Manager, Henig Diamonds
